fixes.explanation: The text doesn't say that. It says they "…will all cover their mouths because there is no answer from God." (Micah 3:7). Nobody shushes them, friend. No boss walks in, no order comes down. These guys don't need anybody to shut them up, because when God gives no answer, the silence does it for them.

The king's court never comes up in this verse. Micah says, "…I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD, with justice and courage…" (Micah 3:8). No royal backing, no palace connections. And good thing, because the rulers of Israel are exactly who he's calling out in this passage. Try telling off your boss when your boss is the one signing your paycheck!
